detail: R-statusline-compares-the-raw-weekly-pct-s-badd: statusline() compares the raw weekly pct, so NaN marks a Fable outage

data.title: statusline() compares the raw weekly pct, so NaN marks a Fable outage
data.label: RISK
data.what: statusline() tests float(pct) < WEEKLY_PCT on the payload value, not number(pct): NaN compares False, so with fable on a NaN weekly percentage marks Fable unavailable ('weekly limit nan% used'); a string 'x' raises ValueError. Found in s1 of T-2026-10-31-2046 (fec7), left out of scope.

data.title: tests.env_retries is never read
data.label: RISK
data.what: no reader in state.py, sensors.py or hooks; raising it changes nothing, an environment failure gets no automatic retry
data.fix: implement the retry or drop the key from the schema
data.status_why: reserved key; an automatic retry needs verify to recognise an environment failure, which the agent classifies (human 2026-10-31)

detail: R-record-quota-stores-a-nan-or-infinite-pe-fec7: record_quota stores a NaN or infinite percentage

data.title: record_quota stores a NaN or infinite percentage
data.label: RISK
data.what: number() at runtime-gate.py:506 returns float(value) for NaN/Infinity; record_quota (:512) then writes weekly_pct/five_hour_pct as NaN or Infinity into the quota record, which later comparisons read as never at the limit. Found in T-2026-10-31-1957 (c7fa), left out of scope.
data.status_why: number() drops non-finite values; tests/test_runtime_gate.py test_18 pins it (T-2026-10-31-2046)

detail: R-ask-opens-question-decisions-with-no-dup-712d: ask opens question decisions with no duplicate-text check (rest of afd2, review L1 of T-2026-10-31-1807)

data.title: ask opens question decisions with no duplicate-text check (rest of afd2, review L1 of T-2026-10-31-1807)

detail: R-decision-duplicate-advice-fails-when-the-e3ae: DECISION_DUPLICATE advice fails when the twin belongs to another session (review L2 of T-2026-10-31-1807)

data.title: DECISION_DUPLICATE advice fails when the twin belongs to another session (review L2 of T-2026-10-31-1807)
data.label: RISK
data.what: decision show lists only this session's decisions, so a stale twin from an earlier session cannot be sent from here; only decision fallback gets out.
data.fix: say when the twin is another session's and point straight to decision fallback --id
data.status_why: another session's twin names decision fallback --id; test_a_twin_from_another_session_names_the_fallback pins it (T-2026-10-31-2046)
